subject: Mathematics
source_note: TIE (2023), Mathematics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: D emonstrate mastery of basic concepts in geometry and algebra

sub_topics.title: Use algebra and matrices in problem solving
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of matrices ( 2×2 matrices: operations, determinant, inverse, and transformations)
(b) Apply matrices to solve simultaneous equations of two unknowns (matrix inversion method and Cramer’s rule)

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of matrices ( 2×2 matrices: operations, determinant, inverse, and transformations)
objectives.resources: Visual aids, Coloured blocks, matrix calculators, charts of real life scenarios, graphing calculators
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of algebra are explored clearly

objectives.text: (b) Apply matrices to solve simultaneous equations of two unknowns (matrix inversion method and Cramer’s rule)
objectives.teaching_methods: Questions and answers, Use of technology, Problem solving
objectives.assessment_criteria: Matrices are clearly applied to solve simultaneous equations of two unknowns

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in coordinate geometry, trigonometry, circles, vectors, probability, and statistics

sub_topics.title: Use basic coordinate geometry, trigonometry, and vectors skills in daily life
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of coordinate geometry (midpoint of a line segment, distance between two points on a line, parallel, and perpendicular lines)
(b) Apply sine and cosine rules to find distances or angles of elevation
(c) Derive and use compound angles to solve problems
(d) Explore the basic tenets of vectors (displacement and position vectors, magnitude and direction, sum and differences, multiplication of vectors by a scalar)

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of coordinate geometry (midpoint of a line segment, distance between two points on a line, parallel, and perpendicular lines)
objectives.resources: Graph papers, mathematical sets, graph boards/papers, geometry animation, Mathematical software such as GeoGebra, Mathematica, MATLAB, Maple
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of coordinate geometry are well explored

objectives.text: (b) Apply sine and cosine rules to find distances or angles of elevation
objectives.teaching_methods: Exploration, Use of technology, Problem solving
objectives.assessment_criteria: The sine and cosine rules are clearly applied to find distances and angles of elevation

objectives.text: (c) Derive and use compound angles to solve problems
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, Use of technology, Jigsaw
objectives.assessment_criteria: The compound angles are clearly derived and used to solve problems

objectives.text: (d) Explore the basic tenets of vectors (displacement and position vectors, magnitude and direction, sum and differences, multiplication of vectors by a scalar)

sub_topics.title: Use probability in problem solving
competences: Explore the basic tenets of probability of two events (probability of an event, mutually exclusive events, dependent events, combined events using tree diagrams, tables and formulae)

objectives.text: Explore the basic tenets of probability of two events (probability of an event, mutually exclusive events, dependent events, combined events using tree diagrams, tables and formulae)
objectives.resources: Probability games, probability simulations, charts of real life situations, probability games, probability trees and diagram
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of probability are well explored

sub_topics.title: Use statistics in problem solving
competences: Explore the basic tenets of statistics (frequency distribution, measures of central tendency, histogram, frequency polygon, and cumulative frequency curve ‘ogive’)

objectives.text: Explore the basic tenets of statistics (frequency distribution, measures of central tendency, histogram, frequency polygon, and cumulative frequency curve ‘ogive’)
objectives.resources: Statistical calculators, statistical charts and graphs, graph paper, real-life case studies charts, data visualisation tools calculators, mathematical sets, chalks, graph boards/ papers, and other relevant resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of statistics are explored clearly
